title: Force fields bending light seen in the Navy tic tac video

tellings.quote: >> The force fields interact with light when when when you see and you can see it on the tic tac video. the Navy pilots.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent years among tall white beings in Nevada, points to the Navy "Tic Tac" video, footage taken by Navy fighter pilots in 2004 of a white oval object shaped like the mint. He says the craft are wrapped in force fields that interact with light, and that you can see this bending of light in that video. If he is right, the video would show the same technology he says he saw up close.
